title: submit() payload
description: Structure of a submission. Violating it (missing/extra keys, wrong JSON types, more than 30 findings, more than 10 evidence ids counted with repeats, explanation over 1000 code points) ends the episode with reward -1 and an error in the grader log. Everything else is matched exactly against truth: a structurally valid finding with an unknown type, a different currency spelling, a wrong amount or ids is a false positive, not a crash. Ids, type and currency are compared exactly (no case folding or trimming); the one published alias is doc_id <-> invoice_id/payment_id of the same document. Amounts are in the functional currency (manifest.base_currency), tolerance from truth.json (0 by default). Reward never depends on explanation.

id.description: Exact id string of an open record.

type.description: One of duplicate_invoice, payment_allocation, fx_error, period_cutoff; any other string never matches.

affected_ids.description: duplicate_invoice: both invoice_ids; payment_allocation: [payment_id, invoice_id]; fx_error: [invoice_id] or [payment_id]; period_cutoff: [invoice_id]. Compared as a set.

claimed_amount_minor.description: Absolute misstatement in functional-currency minor units: a JSON integer.

currency.description: The functional currency code, exactly as in manifest.base_currency.

evidence_ids.description: Records that together prove the issue (documents, booking rows, the policy fx row). TP needs one admissible evidence set to be a subset.
